title: Apply for a good behaviour period
summary: Learn about and apply for a 12-month good behaviour period if you are suspended from driving due to excessive demerit points.
intro:
If you have an unrestricted NSW Driver Licence and you've received a notice of suspension due to excessive demerit points, you may be eligible to elect a 12-month good behaviour period.

You must apply to elect a good behaviour period before your suspension starts.

You can apply online if there are at least 2 business days left before your suspension.

Note: You cannot change your mind and choose the suspension after you've applied for the good behaviour period. Before you apply, make sure you read the conditions.
who_can_apply: Your suspension letter states you can apply for the good behaviour period.
The suspension period has not started.
You hold at least one unrestricted NSW Driver Licence.
You only hold a provisional or learner licence.

how_to_steps.text: Read the conditions of the good behaviour period.
Log in, create a MyServiceNSW Account, or continue as a guest.
Follow the prompts to submit your application.
you'll get a digital receipt straight away
you'll receive a letter of confirmation in the post within 14 business days
you can continue to drive as long as you meet the conditions.

faqs.q: When must I apply for a good behaviour period?
faqs.a: You must apply before your suspension starts.

faqs.q: What happens if I get demerit points during the good behaviour period?
faqs.a: If you get 2 or more demerit points during the 12 months, all your licences will be suspended for double the original suspension period.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a good behaviour period?
faqs.a: You can apply online if there are at least 2 business days left before your suspension. You must read the conditions first, then select 'Apply online' and follow the prompts.
